title: Visa Strategy Navigator
description: Scores 7 US work visa pathways (H-1B, O-1A, O-1B, L-1A, L-1B, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW) against user profile and models green card timeline. Tab 1: pathway scorer — weights 10 profile factors (specialty occupation, extraordinary ability, multinational role, etc.) against FY2025-26 USCIS approval rates to produce a ranked pathway matrix. Tab 2: GC timeline modeler — projects priority date movement for EB-1/EB-2/EB-3 by country of birth using DOS Visa Bulletin backlog data. Legal disclaimer prominently displayed.
data_vintage: USCIS FY2025-26 approval rates · DOS Visa Bulletin GC backlog estimates · 7 visa pathway scoring rubric
